void use(Object? x) {}

abstract class It {
  Future<int?> read();
}

abstract class Api {
  Future<String?> first();
  Future<String?> next(String page);
}

// CASE dart_while_reader expect=pass
Future<void> r1(It it) async {
  int? item;
  while ((item = await it.read()) != null) {
    use(item);
  }
}

// CASE dart_for_reader expect=pass
Future<void> r2(It it) async {
  for (int? item; (item = await it.read()) != null;) {
    use(item);
  }
}

// CASE dart_for_page_body_update expect=pass
Future<void> r6(Api api) async {
  for (var page = await api.first(), i = 0; page != null; i++) {
    use(page);
    page = await api.next(page);
  }
}

// CASE dart_while_page_body_update expect=pass
Future<void> r7(Api api) async {
  var page = await api.first();
  while (page != null) {
    use(page);
    page = await api.next(page);
  }
}

// CASE dart_single_page_body_update expect=pass
Future<void> r8(Api api) async {
  for (var page = await api.first(); page != null;) {
    use(page);
    page = await api.next(page);
  }
}
